Can you move this to a common directory and combine with the ventura files?  Looks like a lot of content in this patch is duplicated.

We already have the `fb-liquid-cooled` machine feature which you should be able to use for the install determination.
+1 Lets move this to a common place and reuse most of this logic from Ventura.
I moved the duplicated content to the common layer and only overrode critical-leak-assert-handler in the ventura2 layer. Could you please help review the new update?
@eldin.lee@quantatw.com Don't you need to drop the common part from ventura layer now or is there a separate patch which takes care of that?
Acknowledged
Please fix the permissions on this file.
Done
Would the install of this file be taken care by the install rule in common layer?
Why do you think any of this logic is specific to ventura2? We do all these actions on ventura as well, right?
Acknowledged

You're right, this logic is not ventura2-specific.

I've refactored it into a common handler with platform hooks.
Platform-specific logic is now moved to:
`meta-facebook/meta-ventura2/.../critical-leak-assert-handler-platform.sh`

The common code calls _platform_* functions to get platform-specific
data, so the same rack leak power-off flow can be reused across platforms.

If this approach works, I will follow up after the merge and notify the
ventura team to update their platform-specific implementation accordingly.
